request.name: List account users

description.content: List all users assigned to an account. Supports `?include=roles` to sideload role assignments.

query.description: Sideload related resources (e.g. `roles`)
Filter by exact email address
Filter by first name (partial, case-insensitive)
Filter by last name (partial, case-insensitive)
Filter by the user's business-system identifier (the same value returned in `external_reference.business_system`).
Filter by role ID. Accepts a comma-separated list; users must have ALL listed roles on this account (AND). Example: filter[roles.id]=1,2
Filter by role ID. Accepts a comma-separated list; users must have ANY of the listed roles on this account (OR). Example: filter[roles.id:includes]=1,2
Filter by role ID. Accepts a comma-separated list; returns users who do NOT have ANY of the listed roles on this account. Example: filter[roles.id:excludes]=1,2
Filter by exact `job_role` (e.g. `Branch Manager`). Pass the same value returned in the `job_role` attribute on the response.
Filter by partial `job_role` match (case-insensitive). Example: `Manager` matches users whose `job_role` is `Branch Manager` or `Service Manager`.
Filter to users whose most recent login is on or after the given ISO 8601 timestamp. Example: filter[last_login_at:gte]=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
Filter to users whose most recent login is on or before the given ISO 8601 timestamp.
Filter users by whether a `last_login_at` timestamp exists. Use `true` to list only users who have logged in at least once, or `false` to list only users who have never logged in.

Sort the results. Accepts a comma-separated list of fields; prefix any field with `-` for descending. The first field is the primary sort key; subsequent fields break ties. Allowed fields: `last_login_at`, `roles.name`, `job_role`. Examples: `sort=last_login_at`, `sort=-job_role`, `sort=roles.name,-last_login_at`. Defaults to `last_name asc, first_name asc` when omitted. For `roles.name`, multi-role users are placed by their alphabetically first role (asc) or last role (desc) on this account. Empty/null values for any sortable column are always grouped at the end (NULLS LAST) regardless of direction.
